title.narrative: Strategic Sector Cooperation on Maritime development Between Denmark and Indonesia, Inception phase

description.narrative:
To assess the potential for further cooperation in selected areas within maritime development between the two countries and support green maritime practises, blue growth and sustainable marine resource management in Indonesia
Key results: - A clear understanding of how Danish expertise can complement Indonesian needs within selected maritime areas - Indonesian authorities and other relevant stakeholders have gained knowledge that can be applied when it comes to development and implementation of a marine spatial plan and the improvement of framework conditions and business development within green maritime practises - Potential future topics of cooperation have been identified
F2: 2021-8640
